result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders.

In `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6514), I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery. This is the same filter the quarterly purchase-order report uses. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say "non-cancelled". Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran the `*PurchaseOrder*` and `*SalesRep*` tests before the Javadoc edit, and they passed. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or run your Anna/Bob example.
